C9000089.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 089 (Bounded-distortion L1 embeddings of planar and bounded-treewidth graphs.; papers: Planar Graph Metrics Embed into L1 with Constant Distortion; L1 Embeddings of Graphs of Bounded Treewidth; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/089.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

P89_MAIN.statement: Planar manuscript thm:main: a universal L1 distortion bound for all finite positively weighted planar graphs.

P89_GEOMETRY.statement: Column realization, geodesics, noncrossing separation, connected distance sublevels, radial cells, and padding (geometry.tex).

P89_INTERPOLATION.statement: int:interpolation: switch-respecting approximation with shared atoms and chart control.

P89_MAIN_RAY.statement: main:ray: failure of the main raise supplies a descending shortest path and its prefix inequality.

P89_BARRIER.statement: pack:barrier: a sufficiently low nearby separating tip provides component-refined separation.

P89_LOCALIZATION.statement: pack:near-path: every selected surviving seed in the narrow-band ball is within j+epsilon+2a1 of two extremal paths of length at most 4R.

P89_PACK.statement: pack:bound: at most 2+ceil(1600R/g) surviving groups meet a narrow-band ball of radius 4R.

P89_SECONDARY.statement: sec:admitted-success and sec:remaining: isolated secondary proposals or transverse increments separate surviving pairs.

P89_PERSISTENCE.statement: pad:persistence: chart-splitting probabilities are bounded independently of column count and construction history.

P89_ASSEMBLY.statement: Movement, local success, chart persistence, and scale spacing assemble the planar L1 embedding.

T89_MAIN.statement: Treewidth thm:main: for bag size k a distortion bound C_k is independent of graph size, decomposition depth, and edge-length ratios.

T89_PARTICLES.statement: lem:trace-update, lem:particle-bounds, prop:particle-realization: arbitrarily many updates preserve bag traces and a uniform Lipschitz invariant.

T89_COBAG.statement: prop:cobag: padded perturbations and reservations give a co-bag lower comparison and a uniform upper comparison.

T89_PADDED.statement: thm:padded: bounded-treewidth metrics have partitions with uniform diameter and padding parameters depending only on bag size.

T89_CKR.statement: CKR arXiv:1006.3970v2 Theorem 4.4: the quoted symmetric bounded-state Markov-flow bound. Not rechecked in this mission.

T89_TRANSPORT.statement: lem:gluing and prop:uncertainty: consistent bag laws glue and common-submeasure uncertainty transports along arbitrary bag paths.

T89_ANCHORS.statement: lem:cache-defined and lem:anchor-tests: a bounded deterministic anchor cache supports persistent reservations and uncertainty tests.

T89_LOWER.statement: prop:combined-lower via youngest-crossing, old-distant, obstruction, protected-successor and younger-crossing anchor lemmas.

L89_CORE.statement: For arbitrary noncrossing models with a bounded broad-path relation, genuine-distance profiles, and retained witnesses, all finite seed families localize within j+err+2a of two length-L extreme traces; b-separated chosen seeds satisfy card <= 2+2L/(b-2rho). The manuscript constants give card <= 800160050.

L89_BRIDGE.statement: The actual distance field, eligibility, bands, terminal switches, and witness selection in pack:bound satisfy the hypotheses of L89_CORE.

L89_COUNT.statement: Pairwise broad-intrinsic b-separated seeds with broad locating paths of length rho to two length-L paths have cardinality at most 2+2L/(b-2rho), when b>2rho.

G89_GEODESICS.statement: geo:geodesics: finite closed-switch column quotients have component metrics, attained finite shortest words, and the stated vertical transfers.

G89_PADDING.statement: geo:padding: under a1<=g/1000, points whose radial values are farther than 0.02g from layer interfaces and lie in distinct width-g cells have broad intrinsic distance greater than 0.01g.
